event: Open-sourced the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the connector standard payment MCP servers are later built on
source_quote: Today, we're open-sourcing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a new standard for connecting AI assistants to the systems where data lives

event: Unveiled Agent Pay, tokenized agentic payments technology giving consumers control over what an agent can purchase
source_quote: Consumers will have complete control over what the agent is allowed to purchase on their behalf, ensuring that the payments they make are securely authorized and identified.

event: Launched Visa Intelligent Commerce, opening its payments network to AI-agent developers
source_quote: a groundbreaking initiative that opens Visa's payments network to developers and engineers building the first generation of true AI commerce.

event: x402 protocol launched, embedding payments into HTTP via the 402 status code
source_quote: x402 launched in May 2025 with a simple idea: embed payments directly into HTTP using the long-dormant 402 status code.

event: Began piloting its MCP server for building payments integrations with LLMs
source_quote: We are piloting our MCP server to empower developers to build their payments integration with Adyen using large language models (LLMs).

event: Publicly launched its identity-and-payments platform for AI agents, later described as the KYAPay protocol
source_quote: Today marks the public launch of Skyfire platform, the first infrastructure layer purpose-built to give AI agents identity and payment capabilities—turning them into real, verified customers.

event: Launched its MCP server connecting AI tools to Razorpay's payment infrastructure
source_quote: Razorpay's MCP server allows a business's AI-assistants to connect and talk easily with Razorpay's infrastructure

event: Launched its AI-ready MCP server to let merchants automate workflows via AI tools
source_quote: The launch of our MCP Server is a natural step forward – helping merchants integrate, automate, and innovate more easily using AI.

event: Announced the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), using signed Mandates as proof of user authorization
source_quote: Today, Google announced the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), an open protocol developed with leading payments and technology companies to securely initiate and transact agent-led payments across platforms.

event: Launched the A2A x402 extension with Coinbase, Ethereum Foundation and MetaMask for agent-based crypto payments
source_quote: in collaboration with Coinbase, Ethereum Foundation, MetaMask and other leading organizations, we have extended the core constructs of AP2 and launched the A2A x402 extension, a production-ready solution for agent-based crypto payments

event: Announced intent to launch the x402 Foundation to govern the x402 protocol
source_quote: Cloudflare is partnering with Coinbase to create the x402 Foundation. This foundation's mission will be to encourage the adoption of the x402 protocol

event: Released the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and launched Instant Checkout in ChatGPT, starting with Etsy
source_quote: ChatGPT users in the US can buy goods from US-based Etsy businesses – and, coming soon, over a million Shopify merchants, like Glossier, Vuori, Spanx and SKIMS – directly in the chat.

event: Announced the Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP), developed with Cloudflare
source_quote: Visa Inc. (NYSE: V) today unveiled Trusted Agent Protocol, establishing a foundational framework for agentic commerce that enables secure communication between AI agents and merchants during every step of a transaction.

event: Partnered with OpenAI, adopting the Agentic Commerce Protocol for ChatGPT commerce
source_quote: By partnering with OpenAI and adopting the Agentic Commerce Protocol, PayPal will power payments and commerce experiences that help people go from chat to checkout in just a few taps for our joint customer bases.

event: Announced support for the Agentic Commerce Protocol for enterprise merchants
source_quote: Checkout.com, a leading global digital payments company, today announced its support for the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)

event: Marked MCP's first anniversary with a new specification version release
source_quote: we hit the first anniversary milestone today - we're also releasing a brand-new MCP specification version.

event: Announced the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), built with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target and Walmart
source_quote: The Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) is an open-source standard designed to power the next generation of agentic commerce.

event: Announced the Machine Payments Protocol (MPP), co-authored by Tempo and Stripe
source_quote: co-authored by Tempo and Stripe

event: Said it is allowing merchants to use their own checkout experiences instead of the initial Instant Checkout, to focus on product discovery (as reported)
source_quote: We've found that the initial version of Instant Checkout did not offer the level of flexibility that we aspire to provide, so we're allowing merchants to use their own checkout experiences while we focus our efforts on product discovery.

event: Launched Intelligent Commerce Connect, a single integration for agents to pay and merchants to accept agentic transactions
source_quote: Part of the Visa Intelligent Commerce portfolio, Intelligent Commerce Connect will enable more ways for agents to pay and merchants to accept agentic transactions in a single integration

event: Donated the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) to the FIDO Alliance
source_quote: Transitioning ownership to the FIDO Alliance ensures AP2 remains platform-agnostic and community-led, while accelerating adoption of secure agentic payments.

event: Launched Circle Agent Stack, including Agent Wallets with policy-based USDC spend limits
source_quote: Agent Wallets give agents a way to hold and move USDC under human-defined policies.

event: Launched an agentic cards API using Visa Intelligent Commerce and Basis Theory, letting agents pay with real Visa cards
source_quote: The agentic economy has been missing its most basic piece of infrastructure: a secure, open payment layer that can work for every agent, on every platform

event: Launched Agent Pay for Machines for high-frequency, low-value machine-to-machine payments
source_quote: Mastercard has launched Agent Pay for Machines, a payments service designed to handle automated, high-frequency, low-value transactions executed by AI agents.

event: Announced Adyen Agentic, a suite of modular APIs for selling through conversational AI platforms
source_quote: Adyen Agentic, a suite of modular APIs that enables enterprises to sell through conversational AI platforms without rebuilding their commerce systems for each new channel.

event: Launched AgentOS, a toolkit for operating an Airwallex account from AI agent environments
source_quote: That is why we built Airwallex AgentOS: a toolkit for any agent to operate Airwallex end to end from your preferred AI platform.

event: Announced Monetization Gateway, letting customers charge AI agents for web pages, datasets, APIs or MCP tools
source_quote: Today, we are announcing the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway, an engine that will give Cloudflare customers the ability to charge for any asset protected by Cloudflare: web pages, datasets, APIs, or MCP tools.

event: x402 Foundation had its operational launch with 40 member organizations
source_quote: Since the Foundation's intent to launch in April, 40 organizations have joined as members.

event: Published the Agentic Payments Readiness Report 2026, scoring 13 payment providers on 7 agent-readiness dimensions (by the maintainers of this list)
source_quote: Every provider in the sample has shipped something agent-facing, but a capability that is official, money-moving and self-serve all at once is rare.

event: Scheduled change: Stripe MCP stops accepting full-access secret keys or restricted keys without the Agent tag
source_quote: Beginning October 31, 2026, Stripe MCP no longer accepts full-access secret keys or restricted API keys without the Agent tag.
